the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: construct the map on K-injective representatives through the chain g_! = h_!f_! = h_*f_! followed by h_* of the K-injective resolution, the first equality from the composition lemma (whose hypothesis that the upper morphism be separated and locally of finite type is met by the proper h) and the second from properness; invertibility in the torsion ring case: work locally on Z, bound the fibre dimension, use the finite cohomological dimension of Rh_*, and reduce to the vanishing of R^qh_*(f_!F) for q > 0, which follows from the stalk description of f_! (stalks supported where the extension of residue fields is finite), the proper base change theorem, and vanishing for sheaves supported in closed points; the bounded-below torsion case follows by the same argument as in the earlier exchange lemma with the stalk lemma substituted (source lines 3197-3255)
